press_references.value: Oshi Health Launches Access+ to Help GI Practices Expand Capacity, Boost Revenue and Retention, and Improve Patient Outcomes

product_launches.description: Oshi Health launched Access+, a turn-key telehealth staffing and multidisciplinary GI care service for local practices, offering GI-trained APPs with extended hours and integrated billing via the practice EMR to expand capacity, increase revenue, and improve outcomes.

overview_description.description: Oshi Health is a virtual-first gastroenterology (GI) clinic that diagnoses, treats and remotely monitors digestive (GI) conditions. Patients work with Oshi Health's integrated care team of gastroenterologists and GI-specialized nurse practitioners, registered dietitians, behavioral psychologists and health coaches to determine the root causes of their symptoms and use a personalized care plan that includes medication, dietary interventions and gut-brain behavioral therapy to get symptoms under control.

about_short_description.short_description: Oshi Health is a digital health platform that provides personalized support and resources for people with digestive health conditions.

identifier.value: Oshi Health Virtual Whole-Person GI Care

product.name: Oshi Health Virtual Whole-Person GI Care
product.description: A virtual gastrointestinal care service that combines medical, nutrition, and gut-brain support to diagnose, treat, and manage digestive symptoms and conditions.

product.name: GI Medical Evaluation and Treatment
product.description: Virtual evaluation and treatment from gastroenterologists and GI-trained providers, including symptom assessment, diagnosis, medication management, testing, and referrals.

product.name: GI Nutrition Care
product.description: Personalized nutrition counseling from GI-trained registered dietitians to identify dietary factors, improve nourishment, and manage digestive symptoms and conditions.

product.name: Gut-Brain Behavioral Health Care
product.description: Behavioral support from gut-brain specialists to address the relationship between digestive symptoms, stress, emotions, and nervous-system responses.

identifier.value: Oshi Health Care Coordination and Digital Patient Support

product.name: Oshi Health Care Coordination and Digital Patient Support
product.description: Digital and administrative support that helps patients manage GI care through virtual appointments, secure messaging, records coordination, referrals, and personalized resources.

identifier.value: Oshi Health for Employers and Health Plans

product.name: Oshi Health for Employers and Health Plans
product.description: A virtual GI care offering for employers and health plans that provides covered members with coordinated digestive healthcare and population-level support.
